authority_note: 本契约由 dualsdr-ab1 任务固化; singlesdr-ab1 与 dualsdr-ab1 的板端 loader/runner 均以本文件 + scripts/radioml_dualsdr_common.py + scripts/radioml_dualsdr_burst.py 为权威。

conversion_contract.duplication: cyclic_tile_1024_to_payload: payload[k] = iq[k mod 1024], k=0..53759; 52 full periods + first 512 of the 53rd period (53760 = 52*1024 + 512)
conversion_contract.scaling_quantize: CI16: interleaved int16 [I0,Q0,...] = lround(tiled * scale), scale = 2048 / native_rms(original_1024), clamp [-32768,32767]; lround = half-away-from-zero (C++ std::llround, NOT numpy.rint)
conversion_contract.unscale: native_rms(original_1024) / 2048.0  (maps recovered counts back to original f32 domain)
conversion_contract.model_window: first 1024 complex samples of the RECOVERED payload (after wide-linear IQ compensation + coarse/fine CFO + fractional timing + payload-gain recovery), then * unscale
conversion_contract.resampling: NONE (rate unchanged 2.56 Msps; no resample/filter/normalize beyond recovery)

burst_sha_scale_formula.payload_sha_post: sha256(clip(lround(i16 * tx_scale))) where tx_scale = 2048 / native_rms(i16 counts)
burst_sha_scale_formula.tx_scale: 2048 / native_rms(payload counts); == 1.0 when .i16 already at RMS 2048

red_lines_unchanged: no training / no model swap / no per-class recovery or capture selection
residual 0.100 gate + max 3 recapture + last-capture selection
RX manual gain 35 dB, center 2.4 GHz, rate 2.56 Msps, RX/TX BW 18 MHz

short24_selection_rule.definition: for each raw24_class c in 0..23, take the frame with dataset_snr_db==30 and the SMALLEST selection_id; requires exactly one 30 dB frame per class else fail-closed
short24_selection_rule.purpose: board smoke: verify transport/identity/output integrity only; NOT accuracy measurement
short24_selection_rule.note: label/SNR never used for recovery or prediction; short24 selection uses label only to pick one frame per class for the identity/smoke pass

board_semantics.finite: 1 iff board_pred is a valid 0..23 argmax
board_semantics.hard_invalid: 1 iff irrecoverable (clip / residual > 0.30); NEVER forced to success
board_semantics.board_pred: raw24 class index 0..23, or -1 sentinel when finite==0
board_semantics.tx_stop_ok / rx_restore_ok: dual-SDR TX/RX restore flags (single-SDR sets tx flags N/A or 1)

phases.coexist_note: both phase names must coexist in gate9_phase.hpp + board_gate9_full_chain_rml23.cpp when the user merges the two PATCHes
